# fortiappseccloud_waf_caching_compression

Configures caching and compression for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/caching_compression`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_caching_compression` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_caching_compression" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status = true

    cache {
      status            = true
      cache_timeout     = 120
      timeout_type      = "minutes"
      allow_method      = "GET,HEAD"
      allow_return_code = "200"
    }

    compress {
      status = true
    }

    cookie_list {
      item {
        name = "session-cookie"
      }
    }

    content_type_list {
      item {
        type = "text/html"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- The module, cache, and compression statuses are coupled. When enabling this module, configure `status`, `cache.status`, and `compress.status` together as shown.

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `cache` (Optional Block) — Cache settings. Omission preserves the current nested object.
    - `cache.allow_method` (Optional, Computed, one of `GET,HEAD`, `GET,HEAD,OPTIONS`, `GET,HEAD,OPTIONS,PUT,POST,PATCH,DELETE`) — Allow method.
    - `cache.allow_return_code` (Optional, Computed, one of `200`, `200,206`, `200,206,301,302`) — Allow return code.
    - `cache.cache_timeout` (Optional, Computed, default 60) — Cache timeout.
    - `cache.status` (Optional, Computed) — Status.
    - `cache.timeout_type` (Optional, Computed, one of `hours`, `minutes`) — Timeout type.
  - `compress` (Optional Block) — Compress settings. Omission preserves the current nested object.
    - `compress.status` (Optional, Computed) — Status.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables caching and compression. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `content_type_list` (Optional Block, at most 10 items) — Owns the ordered `content_type_list.item` blocks.
      - `content_type_list.item.type` (Required, one of `application/javascript`, `application/json`, `application/rss+xml`, `application/soap+xml`, `application/x-javascript`, `application/xml(or)text/xml`, `text/css`, `text/html`, `text/javascript`, `text/plain`) — Response content type eligible for caching or compression.
    - `cookie_list` (Optional Block, at most 32 items) — Owns the ordered `cookie_list.item` blocks.
      - `cookie_list.item.name` (Required, maximum 126 UTF-8 characters) — Cookie name used by the caching or compression policy.
    - `rule_list` (Optional Block, at most 32 items) — Owns the ordered `rule_list.item` blocks.
      - `rule_list.item.bypass_arg` (Optional, Computed) — Bypass arg. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.bypass_arg_value` (Optional, Computed, maximum 128 UTF-8 characters) — Bypass arg value.
      - `rule_list.item.bypass_cookie` (Optional, Computed) — Bypass cookie. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.bypass_cookie_value` (Optional, Computed, maximum 128 UTF-8 characters) — Bypass cookie value.
      - `rule_list.item.method` (Optional, Computed, one of `any`, `connect`, `delete`, `get`, `head`, `options`, `patch`, `post`, `put`, `trace`) — Method.
      - `rule_list.item.url` (Optional, Computed, maximum 255 UTF-8 characters) — Request URL.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_caching_compression.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy forgets this app-scoped resource without sending a disabling PUT. The remote application caching and compression configuration remains unchanged and Terraform emits a warning. This behavior does not apply to `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_caching_compression`, which disables the template module by setting its reviewed top-level, cache, and compression statuses false together.
